groups.label: Agriculture and rural development
groups.description: Farming, irrigation, fisheries, food processing, and programmes aimed at rural livelihoods.

groups.label: Culture, media and sport
groups.description: Arts and heritage, broadcasting and information, tourism, youth affairs and sport.

groups.label: Defence and security
groups.description: The armed forces, defence pensions and production, home affairs, police and border management.

groups.label: Education, skills and research
groups.description: School and higher education, skill development, and scientific and industrial research.

groups.label: Energy, industry and the economy
groups.description: Power, petroleum, coal, mines, heavy industry, commerce, corporate affairs and financial services.

groups.label: Environment and climate
groups.description: Environment, forests and climate change, earth sciences, and new and renewable energy.

groups.label: Government and public administration
groups.description: The central machinery of government: the legislature, judiciary, tax administration, external affairs and general services.

groups.label: Health and social protection
groups.description: Health and family welfare, pharmaceuticals, women and child development, social justice and tribal affairs.

groups.label: Interest and debt service
groups.description: Interest payments and the servicing of public debt from previous borrowing. It is usually the second largest thing the union spends on, and it is a legally committed charge rather than a discretionary programme.

groups.label: Grants to states and union territories
groups.description: Union grants to state governments and the budgets of the union territories — Finance Commission grants, special assistance and territory administration. Not the states’ constitutional share of taxes, which is deducted earlier and sits outside this budget.

groups.label: Transport, housing and infrastructure
groups.description: Railways, roads, ports, civil aviation, telecommunications, housing and urban development.
